title: Banishment routing adapter — Banisher of the Light + Bazoo the Soul-Eater
testCoverage: Banisher replacement is global across both teams and uses physical owner seat encoded in UID
face-down Banisher does not replace a GY destination
tokens cease to exist rather than entering GY or banished
Bazoo can banish 1–3 monsters from its controller team's shared GY, including partner-owned cards
opponent GY is excluded; stale, duplicate, zero, and four-card selections are rejected
Bazoo once-per-turn and Main Phase/open-chain timing
temporary ATK bonus +300 per banished monster persists through the opponent turn and expires afterward
negated resolution and source leaving field do not grant ATK
physical inventory, hands, deck limits, zones and player data remain conserved
fixtureStrategy: Real card IDs and official sources are fixed in production defaults. Tests inject two already-playable Normal Monster IDs only as temporary fixture aliases because these candidates are not yet in the engine-v9 playable catalog. Fixture aliases do not change the source IDs, catalog, certification count, allowlist, or player inventory.
limitations: M61 still owns the protected resolver/catalog/certification files; no integration into the live effect resolver or commands is attempted.
Banisher is verified as a destination decision helper; the global replacement hook still requires resolver handoff.
Live Discord, production deployment, merge and backup restoration were not exercised.
